note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = dial centre. Plan sizes from the trace of Orient USA's front image of RA-AC0M02B30B (same dial, case and strap as B10B; 38.4 mm case, listings; the image reads 43.7 mm lug to lug against the listed 44 mm). Heights are a front-relief reading of the listed 12.5 mm with its domed crystal (no side photo). House method: modelled polished case, bezel, lugs, crown, applied markers and hands; photo maps only for the dial print and the leather strap.

case.note: flank to r 19.2, rounded shoulder, polished bezel sloping in to the crystal ring at 16.63

strap.note: 20 mm, house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; starts under the case

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

review.subtitle: Orient Bambino 38, black dial, black croc leather strap. Front relief GLB, round 1.
notes: Front reference: Orient USA's own product image of RA-AC0M02B30B, the same watch (the photo supplied is angled).

Case, sloped bezel, domed crystal, lugs, crown, the faceted lancet markers (a pair at 12) and the faceted dauphine hands are modelled in the house polished steel; the dial print (minute track, logo, date) and the strap leather come from the photo.
Heights are estimated from the listed 12.5 mm thickness (no side photo).
